executiveSummary.headline: Establish Clear Location and Meetings Signals Without Assuming Cause
executiveSummary.lead: voco Cancún Zona Hotelera recorded 0.4% AI Consideration and appeared in 1.6% of eligible scenarios, with an 85.2% weighted attribute Reality Gap. These results show very low absolute presence but do not prove a website defect or explain the cause. The hotel should first correct the verified mixed-language room headings on the English page, then organize approved location, meetings, dining, pool, and pet-policy facts so buyers can understand the offer. IHG should separately review the bounded 403 responses without weakening security.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: AI Consideration is the share of 252 comparable monitored answers mentioning the hotel; Scenario Presence is the share of 63 eligible scenarios where it appeared. Reality Gap is a weighted attribute-recognition diagnostic covering 27 tested attributes. None represents bookings, revenue, rank, or traveler exposure.

themes.title: Low Presence Is a Measurement Signal, Not a Diagnosis
themes.what: The hotel appeared in only one comparable answer and one eligible scenario.
themes.whyItMatters: The result supports disciplined content and access review, but no causal website defect should be invented.

themes.title: English Room Content Has Mixed-Language Headings
themes.what: The English hotel page displays Spanish room-category phrases including “Ultimos pisos” and “Habitaciones modernas...”.
themes.whyItMatters: This is a directly observed content-hygiene issue that can interrupt buyer comprehension and should be corrected through IHG content controls.

themes.title: Location and Meetings Facts Need a Buyer-Ready Structure
themes.what: Official content describes a position across from Playa Langosta, access to the Isla Mujeres ferry and Cancún demand anchors, plus three meeting rooms with the combined Mexico room accommodating up to 300.
themes.whyItMatters: Accurate, maintained facts can improve decision context without promising visibility or booking gains.

executiveSummary.successLooksLike: The English page uses consistent English room headings; official and priority partner content accurately explains the Playa Langosta location, Isla Mujeres ferry context, named Cancún anchors, three meeting rooms and setup-qualified capacities; dining, pool, and pet terms are current; and IHG documents the intended automated-access posture.
executiveSummary.closing: The hotel’s low measured presence warrants careful prioritization, not a causal claim. Correct the verified language issue, approve one buyer-ready fact set, preserve accurate operating details, and investigate crawler access through IHG security governance. Measure later without promising rankings, bookings, or revenue. Digital authority: Destination inclusion matters more than inventing backlink volume.
